notes: Every real-place map, with every parameter the pipeline uses. tools/geo/geo-pipeline.mjs reads this file; GeoCatalog.js is generated from it.

places.name: Third Street · Baton Rouge
places.text: Downtown Baton Rouge rebuilt at a compact tactical scale from OpenStreetMap and the USGS 3DEP terrain: the Third Street storefront row, Florida and 4th Street, the surface lot and the Capitol City Press building.

places.name: Sherwood & Florida · Baton Rouge
places.text: The Sherwood Forest Blvd × Florida Blvd crossing in Baton Rouge, rebuilt at a compact tactical scale from OpenStreetMap and USGS 3DEP: the divided boulevards and their slip lanes, the Sherwood Plaza car park, the corner pad and the Asian Supermarket / Dollar Tree building at 11244 Florida Blvd.

places.name: Old State Capitol · Baton Rouge
places.text: Louisiana's Gothic Revival Old State Capitol (1847–52) on North Boulevard, its square and neighbours, rebuilt from OpenStreetMap, Wikidata and USGS 3DEP.

places.name: Independence Hall · Philadelphia
places.text: Independence Hall (1753) on Chestnut Street and Independence Square, Philadelphia, rebuilt from OpenStreetMap, Wikidata and USGS 3DEP.
